name: Ruins of Kardala
summary: The Ruins of Kardala are an ancient Yokudan tomb in western Lower Craglorn, inhabited by Anka-Ra warriors. In the depths of the ruins lies the Apex Stone of the Celestial Warrior. Sandroaches are found in numbers within.
notes: There are three optional summoned bosses, Ahmat the Forgotten, Mazar the Vengeful, and Rajdara the Restless One, each with an individual tomb location. To summon them, you need a Spirit Stone which can drop from slain Yokudan Spirits.
